summary: The Smalltalk Assistant plays onboarding as three acts: two agents talk (on a Claude and a Codex when both are ready), a small mission runs in a split, and an alert appears above the message input before the interview that ends onboarding. Its text is addressed to you and writes no working narration.

replay.detail: Ordinary declaration and mission-run replay is unchanged.

schema.detail: No database or claim schema changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or replication rule changes.

compatibility.detail: The built-in st/onboarding mission has new steps (hello, act-one, act-two, act-three) and a new revision, and the pinned doc/st/guide and the agent/st/assistant description are rewritten. The built-in text is published only by a first setup or st setup --onboarding, and an install that already ran onboarding keeps its published mission and seat until it reruns onboarding explicitly. The mission now names the ready harnesses, so the declaration differs between machines with one and with two.

downtime.detail: No daemon or seat restart is required.

recovery.detail: No store migration or recovery procedure changes.
